coverageRationale.zh: 把 IEEE 2883-2022 的三种净化方法与验证强度写成可复述的判定链：Clear 5% 代表抽样、Purge 全量读取、Destruct 物理检查；把密码擦除单独写成密钥销毁证据，避免把“抽样通过”当“数据必然不可恢复”。
coverageRationale.en: Turns IEEE 2883-2022 into a reproducible decision chain: Clear 5% representative sampling, Purge full read, Destruct physical inspection; cryptographic erase is treated as key-destruction evidence, not as “sampling passed, therefore unrecoverable”.

zh.principle: **标准**：存储净化（Storage Sanitization）。IEEE 2883-2022 把存储净化分成三种方法：Clear 用接口可用的逻辑覆写/块擦除，防简单非侵入恢复；Purge 用覆写、块擦除或密码擦除，防实验室级恢复；Destruct 用粉碎、焚烧、熔化等让介质不可再用。标准同时覆盖逻辑存储与物理存储，并按 HDD、SSD、光介质、可移动介质以及 SATA/SAS/NVMe 接口给出具体要求。
zh.why: 三种方法对应不同威胁模型与验证强度。Clear 只需代表抽样；Purge 要全量读取；Destruct 只能物理检查。把验证强度和方法混在一起，会出现“做了 Clear 却按 Purge 宣称”的过度承诺。密码擦除（CE）走另一条路径：数据仍以密文留在介质上，但媒体加密密钥被销毁；没有密钥，残留密文不可解。
zh.used: 数据生命周期先选方法：复用/转售可选 Purge 以保留介质价值；报废可选 Destruct；低敏临时清理可选 Clear，但要接受抽样验证的检测概率。Clear 抽样至少覆盖 5% 可寻址空间，或每 10,000 等分子区取 2 点并加首尾；Purge 读全可寻址空间；CE 要保留密钥销毁、密钥层级与访问控制证据；Destruct 保留物理检查记录。
zh.broken: 常见错误包括：把 Clear 当 Purge；把一次覆写当对所有介质都有效；忽略 SSD 磨损均衡、预留区和坏块导致的可寻址范围之外残留；把 5% 抽样通过当成“数据必然不可恢复”。CE 也不自动安全：密钥是否真销毁、是否有备份密钥、密钥管理是否可审计，决定 CE 是否成立。标准给方法与验证，不给具体产品的合规证书。### 形式模型
zh.history:
IEEE 2883-2022 于 2022-06-16 董事会批准、2022-08-17 发布，是存储净化从零散覆写指南走向方法/介质/接口分层标准的节点。IEEE 2883.1-2025 于 2025-02-12 批准、2025-06-19 发布，补充 Clear/Purge/Destruct 在复用、转售、报废和循环经济中的选择与证据要求。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：存储净化的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 存储净化 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

**参数与状态规模**

公式 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\) 的输入、输出和单位必须逐项登记；复算顺序为：1. 读取标准规定的密钥/分组/模式参数 2. 按标准表换算等效强度 3. 取最弱分量作为系统强度。

状态规模、密钥长度、分组长度和轮数决定复杂度；这些量不能从标题推断，必须以标准或实现文档为准。

**测试向量与实现边界**

标准测试向量只证明某组输入在某个实现中产生了预期输出，不证明所有参数都安全。记录测试向量时至少要写：算法/模式、密钥、明文或消息、随机数/IV、输出长度、实现版本。该条目已登记的限制是：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

如果实现使用查表、分支或可变时间操作，算法层的证明不能替代侧信道评估；如果协议层没有认证，算法层的机密性也不能阻止替换或重放。

**阅读路线与误用**

把 存储净化 当成“能加密”是不够的：要说明它接受什么输入、在什么假设下成立、输出交给谁。

常见误用包括把示例参数当唯一合法参数、把算法标准当实现认证、把一次测试向量当全参数证明。正文与计算记录要分别标明“来源事实”“形式模型”“未核空白”。

en.principle: **Standard**: Storage Sanitization (存储净化). IEEE 2883-2022 divides storage sanitization into three methods: Clear uses logical overwrite/block erase through the interface against simple non-invasive recovery; Purge uses overwrite, block erase or cryptographic erase against laboratory recovery; Destruct shreds, incinerates or melts media so it cannot be reused. The standard covers logical and physical storage and gives media-specific requirements for HDD, SSD, optical and removable media, plus SATA/SAS/NVMe interfaces.
en.why:
The three methods map to different threat models and verification strengths. Clear needs representative sampling; Purge needs a full read; Destruct needs physical inspection. Mixing method and verification strength produces overclaims such as “Clear performed, Purge claimed”.

Cryptographic erase (CE) takes another path: data remains as ciphertext, but the media encryption key is destroyed; without the key, residual ciphertext cannot be decrypted.
en.used:
The data lifecycle first chooses a method: reuse/resale may use Purge to retain media value; disposal may use Destruct; low-sensitivity temporary cleanup may use Clear but accepts the detection probability of sampling.

Clear samples at least 5% of addressable space, or two points per 10,000 equal subsections plus first/last; Purge reads the whole addressable space; CE keeps key-destruction, key-hierarchy and access-control evidence; Destruct keeps physical-inspection records.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Common errors include: treating Clear as Purge; treating one overwrite as effective on all media; ignoring SSD wear levelling, over-provisioning and bad blocks outside the addressable range; treating a 5% sample pass as proof of unrecoverability.

CE is not automatically safe: whether the key is truly destroyed, whether backup keys exist and whether key management is auditable decide whether CE holds. The standard gives methods and verification, not a product compliance certificate.

Conformance = Requirements ∧ TestVectors；Status ∈ {current, superseded, withdrawn}；Scope = (terms, requirements). Symbols are catalogue-level variables, not standard constants; parameters, test vectors and clauses remain with the registered source. The model states structural relations, not an implementation audit.
en.history:
IEEE 2883-2022 was approved by the IEEE SA Board on 2022-06-16 and published on 2022-08-17, marking the shift from scattered overwrite guides to a method/media/interface standard.

IEEE 2883.1-2025 was approved on 2025-02-12 and published on 2025-06-19, adding method selection and evidence for reuse, resale, disposal and the circular economy.
